import html # Predefined template for a blog post. The placeholders are `{title}` and `{body}`. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Return a safe, sanitized HTML representation of a blog entry. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. This will be escaped to prevent XSS. content : str The main body of the blog post. This will be escaped to prevent XSS. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post ready for display. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("Both heading and content must be strings.") # Escape user supplied data to neutralize malicious scripts. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the predefined template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
